svg.title: Production pipeline design
svg.desc: One parameterized scheduled Databricks job loads Walmart Store Sales files into a Delta table: an initial run loads history and updates, then daily incremental runs load only new files and record them in a tracking table. The team reads dates from the Delta table without calling Walmart again.
svg.text: Production design: load once, update daily, read from Delta
one parameterized job collects the data; the team reads the stored data

g.text: Loads the history files, then catches up on the updates not covered by history. Every file is recorded as loaded.
Finds the one new update, loads only that file, records it. The history is not downloaded again.
Same job, same parameter, one more new file. If nothing new exists, the run adds nothing.
Team needs the update published on 5 October
They query the Delta table, which already holds it. No new Walmart request is made.

svg.text: Proposed design. Parameter names are ours, not Walmart's. Example files and dates are made up, not real Walmart data.
Business-date questions are answered by filtering the stored sales date, not by the Walmart feed date.
